scope: turning (right turns, left turns and U-turns, at intersections and elsewhere)

vocabulary.definition: The operator of a vehicle, meaning a person who drives or has physical control of the vehicle (Texas Transportation Code uses 'operator').

The common area at the junction of two highways or roadways, within the lateral curb lines or, without curbs, the lateral boundary lines of the roadways, as defined in Texas Transportation Code Section 541.303.

The portion of a roadway at an INTERSECTION within the connections of the lateral lines of the sidewalks, or any portion of a roadway distinctly indicated for pedestrian crossing by lines or other markings, as defined in Section 541.302.
A turn made so that the vehicle moves in the opposite direction on the same roadway.
A roadway on which vehicular traffic is allowed to move in only one direction.
A steady green circular indication of a traffic-control signal.
A steady green arrow indication of a traffic-control signal, alone or with another indication.
A steady red circular indication of a traffic-control signal.
A flashing yellow arrow indication of a traffic-control signal permitting a turn in the direction of the arrow after yielding.
A center lane marked on each side by a solid yellow line and a broken yellow line, with left-turn arrows, reserved for left turns by vehicles travelling in either direction.
A paved shoulder, as defined in Section 541.302.
A signal given by the vehicle's signal lamps or by hand and arm to show an intention to turn, change lanes or start from a parked position.
A cane or walking stick that is white or metallic in color, with or without a red tip, carried by a pedestrian who is blind or visually impaired.
An animal specially trained or equipped to help a person with a disability.

rules.title: Turn only when safe
rules.when: about to turn the vehicle to enter a private road or driveway OR otherwise turn the vehicle from a direct course OR move right or left on a roadway
rules.action: make the movement
rules.unless: the movement can be made safely
rules.statement: WHEN about to turn the vehicle to enter a private road or driveway OR otherwise turn the vehicle from a direct course OR move right or left on a roadway, the DRIVER MUST NOT make the movement, UNLESS the movement can be made safely.
rules.note: Texas Transportation Code Section 545.103.

rules.title: Follow turn markers in intersection
rules.when: turning at an INTERSECTION AND authorized markers, buttons or signs within or next to the INTERSECTION direct a course for turning vehicles different from the normal course
rules.action: turn only as directed by the markers, buttons or signs
rules.statement: WHEN turning at an INTERSECTION AND authorized markers, buttons or signs within or next to the INTERSECTION direct a course for turning vehicles different from the normal course, the DRIVER MUST turn only as directed by the markers, buttons or signs.
rules.note: Section 545.101; exact subsection lettering uncertain.

rules.title: Obey turn prohibition signs
rules.when: an official sign prohibits a right turn, a left turn or a U-TURN at a location
rules.action: make the prohibited turn at that location
rules.statement: WHEN an official sign prohibits a right turn, a left turn or a U-TURN at a location, the DRIVER MUST NOT make the prohibited turn at that location.
rules.note: Based on the general duty to comply with official traffic-control devices (Section 544.004).

rules.title: Plan the turn ahead
rules.when: intending to turn
rules.action: move into the proper lane well before the turn, slow down, and look for vehicles, PEDESTRIANS and CYCLISTS before turning
rules.statement: WHEN intending to turn, the DRIVER SHOULD move into the proper lane well before the turn, slow down, and look for vehicles, PEDESTRIANS and CYCLISTS before turning.
rules.note: Texas Driver Handbook guidance; exact wording may differ.

rules.title: Right turn close to right edge
rules.when: making a right turn at an INTERSECTION
rules.action: make both the approach and the turn as closely as practicable to the right-hand curb or edge of the roadway
rules.statement: WHEN making a right turn at an INTERSECTION, the DRIVER MUST make both the approach and the turn as closely as practicable to the right-hand curb or edge of the roadway.
rules.note: Section 545.101(a).

rules.title: Left turn from leftmost lane
rules.when: making a left turn at an INTERSECTION
rules.action: approach the INTERSECTION in the extreme left-hand lane lawfully available to traffic moving in the vehicle's direction
rules.statement: WHEN making a left turn at an INTERSECTION, the DRIVER MUST approach the INTERSECTION in the extreme left-hand lane lawfully available to traffic moving in the vehicle's direction.
rules.note: Section 545.101(b)(1). Where lane markings allow left turns from more than one lane, the marked lanes are lawfully available.

rules.title: Left turn ends in lawful position
rules.when: making a left turn at an INTERSECTION
rules.action: after entering the INTERSECTION, turn left and leave the INTERSECTION so as to arrive in a position to lawfully move in the new direction
rules.statement: WHEN making a left turn at an INTERSECTION, the DRIVER MUST after entering the INTERSECTION, turn left and leave the INTERSECTION so as to arrive in a position to lawfully move in the new direction.

rules.title: Left turn to left of intersection center
rules.when: making a left turn at an INTERSECTION
rules.action: turn in the portion of the INTERSECTION to the left of the center of the INTERSECTION, to the extent practicable
rules.statement: WHEN making a left turn at an INTERSECTION, the DRIVER MUST turn in the portion of the INTERSECTION to the left of the center of the INTERSECTION, to the extent practicable.

vague_terms.explanation: does not say when it is impracticable

rules.note: Section 545.101; subsection lettering and exact wording uncertain.

rules.title: Shoulder to slow for right turn
rules.when: about to make a right turn AND there is an IMPROVED SHOULDER to the right of the main traveled portion of the roadway AND it is necessary AND it can be done safely
rules.action: drive on the IMPROVED SHOULDER to decelerate before making the right turn
rules.statement: WHEN about to make a right turn AND there is an IMPROVED SHOULDER to the right of the main traveled portion of the roadway AND it is necessary AND it can be done safely, the DRIVER MAY ONLY drive on the IMPROVED SHOULDER to decelerate before making the right turn.
rules.note: Section 545.058(a) lists several permitted shoulder uses; this rule covers the turning one. Section 545.058 also permits shoulder use to pass a vehicle that is slowing, stopped or preparing to make a left turn.

rules.title: Shoulder to pass a left-turning vehicle
rules.when: a vehicle ahead on the main traveled portion of the highway is slowing, stopped or preparing to make a left turn AND there is an IMPROVED SHOULDER to the right AND it is necessary AND it can be done safely
rules.action: drive on the IMPROVED SHOULDER to pass that vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN a vehicle ahead on the main traveled portion of the highway is slowing, stopped or preparing to make a left turn AND there is an IMPROVED SHOULDER to the right AND it is necessary AND it can be done safely, the DRIVER MAY ONLY drive on the IMPROVED SHOULDER to pass that vehicle.
rules.note: Section 545.058(a).

rules.title: Signal intention to turn
rules.when: intending to turn, change lanes or start from a parked position
rules.action: give a TURN SIGNAL by signal lamps or by hand and arm
rules.statement: WHEN intending to turn, change lanes or start from a parked position, the DRIVER MUST give a TURN SIGNAL by signal lamps or by hand and arm.
rules.note: Section 545.104(a).

rules.title: Signal for last 100 feet
rules.when: intending to turn the vehicle right or left
rules.action: signal continuously for not less than the last 100 feet of movement of the vehicle before the turn
rules.statement: WHEN intending to turn the vehicle right or left, the DRIVER MUST signal continuously for not less than the last 100 feet of movement of the vehicle before the turn.
rules.note: Section 545.104(b).

rules.title: Signal lamps when hand signal not visible
rules.when: the vehicle is constructed or loaded so that a hand and arm signal would not be visible to the front and rear
rules.action: give the TURN SIGNAL by signal lamps
rules.statement: WHEN the vehicle is constructed or loaded so that a hand and arm signal would not be visible to the front and rear, the DRIVER MUST give the TURN SIGNAL by signal lamps.
rules.note: Section 545.106.

rules.title: Hand signal for left turn
rules.when: giving a hand and arm TURN SIGNAL for a left turn
rules.action: extend the hand and arm horizontally from the left side of the vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN giving a hand and arm TURN SIGNAL for a left turn, the DRIVER MUST extend the hand and arm horizontally from the left side of the vehicle.
rules.note: Section 545.107.

rules.title: Hand signal for right turn
rules.when: giving a hand and arm TURN SIGNAL for a right turn
rules.action: extend the hand and arm upward from the left side of the vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN giving a hand and arm TURN SIGNAL for a right turn, the DRIVER MUST extend the hand and arm upward from the left side of the vehicle.
rules.note: Section 545.107. Cyclists are separately allowed to signal a right turn with the right arm extended horizontally.

rules.title: Hand signal for slowing to turn
rules.when: giving a hand and arm signal to stop or decrease speed before a turn
rules.action: extend the hand and arm downward from the left side of the vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN giving a hand and arm signal to stop or decrease speed before a turn, the DRIVER MUST extend the hand and arm downward from the left side of the vehicle.
rules.note: Sections 545.105 and 545.107. Section 545.105 requires a signal before stopping or suddenly decreasing speed.

rules.title: No misleading turn signals
rules.when: the vehicle is not about to turn or change lanes
rules.action: use the turn signal lamps as a courtesy or 'do pass' signal to the operator of another vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN the vehicle is not about to turn or change lanes, the DRIVER MUST NOT use the turn signal lamps as a courtesy or 'do pass' signal to the operator of another vehicle.
rules.note: Section 545.104(c), which also bars lighting the signals on only one side of a parked or disabled vehicle.

rules.title: Left turn: yield to oncoming traffic
rules.when: turning left at an INTERSECTION OR into an alley, private road or driveway
rules.action: yield the right-of-way to a vehicle approaching from the opposite direction that is in the INTERSECTION or so close to it as to be an immediate hazard
rules.statement: WHEN turning left at an INTERSECTION OR into an alley, private road or driveway, the DRIVER MUST yield the right-of-way to a vehicle approaching from the opposite direction that is in the INTERSECTION or so close to it as to be an immediate hazard.
rules.penalty: Misdemeanor; fine of $1 to $200; higher fines if failure to yield causes bodily injury or serious bodily injury.

vague_terms.term: so close to it as to be an immediate hazard
vague_terms.explanation: no distance or time gap given

rules.note: Section 545.152. Enhanced penalty amounts for injury are not stated here because they are uncertain.

rules.title: Turning on green: yield
rules.when: turning right or left while facing a CIRCULAR GREEN SIGNAL
rules.action: yield the right-of-way to other vehicles and to PEDESTRIANS lawfully in the INTERSECTION or an adjacent CROSSWALK
rules.statement: WHEN turning right or left while facing a CIRCULAR GREEN SIGNAL, the DRIVER MUST yield the right-of-way to other vehicles and to PEDESTRIANS lawfully in the INTERSECTION or an adjacent CROSSWALK.
rules.note: Section 544.007(b).

rules.title: Turning after a stop sign: yield
rules.when: turning into or across a roadway after stopping at a stop sign
rules.action: yield the right-of-way to a vehicle that has entered the INTERSECTION from another highway or that is approaching so closely as to be an immediate hazard
rules.statement: WHEN turning into or across a roadway after stopping at a stop sign, the DRIVER MUST yield the right-of-way to a vehicle that has entered the INTERSECTION from another highway or that is approaching so closely as to be an immediate hazard.

vague_terms.term: approaching so closely as to be an immediate hazard
vague_terms.explanation: no distance or time gap given

rules.note: Section 545.153.

rules.title: Turning after a yield sign
rules.when: turning at an INTERSECTION controlled by a yield sign facing the DRIVER
rules.action: slow to a reasonable speed, stop if necessary, and yield the right-of-way to vehicles in the INTERSECTION or approaching so closely as to be an immediate hazard
rules.statement: WHEN turning at an INTERSECTION controlled by a yield sign facing the DRIVER, the DRIVER MUST slow to a reasonable speed, stop if necessary, and yield the right-of-way to vehicles in the INTERSECTION or approaching so closely as to be an immediate hazard.

vague_terms.explanation: leaves when to stop to the driver

vague_terms.term: approaching so closely as to be an immediate hazard
vague_terms.explanation: no distance or time gap given

rules.note: Sections 544.010 and 545.153.

rules.title: Turning from a driveway
rules.when: turning onto a highway from a private road or driveway
rules.action: yield the right-of-way to each vehicle approaching on the highway
rules.statement: WHEN turning onto a highway from a private road or driveway, the DRIVER MUST yield the right-of-way to each vehicle approaching on the highway.
rules.note: Section 545.155.

rules.title: Pedestrians in crosswalk when turning
rules.when: turning across a CROSSWALK where a PEDESTRIAN is crossing on the half of the roadway the vehicle is on OR approaching so closely from the opposite half as to be in danger
rules.action: yield the right-of-way to the PEDESTRIAN, slowing or stopping if necessary
rules.statement: WHEN turning across a CROSSWALK where a PEDESTRIAN is crossing on the half of the roadway the vehicle is on OR approaching so closely from the opposite half as to be in danger, the DRIVER MUST yield the right-of-way to the PEDESTRIAN, slowing or stopping if necessary.

vague_terms.term: approaching so closely from the opposite half as to be in danger

vague_terms.explanation: leaves when to stop to the driver

rules.note: Section 552.003 applies where traffic-control signals are not in place or not in operation; at signals, Section 544.007 and 552.002 apply.

rules.title: Blind or disabled pedestrians
rules.when: approaching an INTERSECTION or CROSSWALK where a PEDESTRIAN carrying a WHITE CANE or accompanied by an ASSISTANCE ANIMAL is crossing or attempting to cross
rules.action: yield the right-of-way to the PEDESTRIAN and take necessary precautions to avoid injuring or endangering the PEDESTRIAN, stopping if necessary
rules.statement: WHEN approaching an INTERSECTION or CROSSWALK where a PEDESTRIAN carrying a WHITE CANE or accompanied by an ASSISTANCE ANIMAL is crossing or attempting to cross, the DRIVER MUST yield the right-of-way to the PEDESTRIAN and take necessary precautions to avoid injuring or endangering the PEDESTRIAN, stopping if necessary.

vague_terms.explanation: leaves when to stop to the driver

rules.note: Section 552.008; applies to all approaching drivers, including turning drivers.

rules.title: Watch for cyclists and motorcyclists when turning
rules.when: turning right or left
rules.action: check for CYCLISTS and motorcyclists, including those approaching from behind on the right or from the opposite direction, and not turn across their path
rules.statement: WHEN turning right or left, the DRIVER SHOULD check for CYCLISTS and motorcyclists, including those approaching from behind on the right or from the opposite direction, and not turn across their path.
rules.note: Texas Driver Handbook sharing-the-road guidance; wording paraphrased.

rules.title: Turn permitted on circular green
rules.when: facing a CIRCULAR GREEN SIGNAL
rules.action: turn right or left
rules.statement: WHEN facing a CIRCULAR GREEN SIGNAL, the DRIVER MAY turn right or left, UNLESS a sign prohibits the turn.
rules.note: Section 544.007(b). The yield duty is rule TURN-YLD-02.

rules.title: Green arrow: only the arrow movement
rules.when: facing a GREEN ARROW
rules.action: cautiously enter the INTERSECTION to make the movement shown by the arrow or another movement permitted by other indications shown at the same time, yielding the right-of-way to PEDESTRIANS lawfully in an adjacent CROSSWALK and to other traffic lawfully in the INTERSECTION
rules.statement: WHEN facing a GREEN ARROW, the DRIVER MAY ONLY cautiously enter the INTERSECTION to make the movement shown by the arrow or another movement permitted by other indications shown at the same time, yielding the right-of-way to PEDESTRIANS lawfully in an adjacent CROSSWALK and to other traffic lawfully in the INTERSECTION.
rules.note: Section 544.007(c). Force is REQUIREMENT because the movement limit is law; MAY ONLY expresses the limit.

rules.title: Stop before turning on red
rules.when: facing a STEADY RED SIGNAL AND intending to turn
rules.action: stop at a clearly marked stop line or, if none, before entering the CROSSWALK on the near side of the INTERSECTION or, if none, before entering the INTERSECTION, before turning
rules.statement: WHEN facing a STEADY RED SIGNAL AND intending to turn, the DRIVER MUST stop at a clearly marked stop line or, if none, before entering the CROSSWALK on the near side of the INTERSECTION or, if none, before entering the INTERSECTION, before turning.
rules.penalty: Misdemeanor; fine of $1 to $200; red-light camera civil penalties may apply where cameras operated before 2019 contracts ended.
rules.note: Section 544.007(d)-(e). Texas banned new red-light cameras in 2019; penalty note uncertain for camera enforcement.

rules.title: Right turn on red
rules.when: facing a STEADY RED SIGNAL AND the DRIVER has stopped as required
rules.action: turn right, after yielding the right-of-way to PEDESTRIANS lawfully in an adjacent CROSSWALK and to other traffic lawfully using the INTERSECTION
rules.statement: WHEN facing a STEADY RED SIGNAL AND the DRIVER has stopped as required, the DRIVER MAY turn right, after yielding the right-of-way to PEDESTRIANS lawfully in an adjacent CROSSWALK and to other traffic lawfully using the INTERSECTION, UNLESS a sign prohibits the turn.
rules.note: Section 544.007(f).

rules.title: Left turn on red, one-way to one-way
rules.when: facing a STEADY RED SIGNAL on a ONE-WAY ROADWAY AND turning left onto a ONE-WAY ROADWAY on which traffic moves to the DRIVER's left AND the DRIVER has stopped as required
rules.action: turn left, after yielding the right-of-way to PEDESTRIANS lawfully in an adjacent CROSSWALK and to other traffic lawfully using the INTERSECTION
rules.statement: WHEN facing a STEADY RED SIGNAL on a ONE-WAY ROADWAY AND turning left onto a ONE-WAY ROADWAY on which traffic moves to the DRIVER's left AND the DRIVER has stopped as required, the DRIVER MAY turn left, after yielding the right-of-way to PEDESTRIANS lawfully in an adjacent CROSSWALK and to other traffic lawfully using the INTERSECTION, UNLESS a sign prohibits the turn.
rules.note: Section 544.007(f).

rules.title: Flashing yellow arrow
rules.when: facing a FLASHING YELLOW ARROW AND turning in the direction of the arrow
rules.action: yield to oncoming traffic and to PEDESTRIANS before turning
rules.statement: WHEN facing a FLASHING YELLOW ARROW AND turning in the direction of the arrow, the DRIVER MUST yield to oncoming traffic and to PEDESTRIANS before turning.
rules.note: Texas Driver Handbook and TxDOT guidance; the left-turn yield duty is also law under Section 545.152.

rules.title: Lane-use arrows
rules.when: in a lane marked with lane-use arrows or a sign showing the movements allowed from that lane
rules.action: make only a movement shown for that lane
rules.statement: WHEN in a lane marked with lane-use arrows or a sign showing the movements allowed from that lane, the DRIVER MUST make only a movement shown for that lane.
rules.note: Based on the duty to obey official traffic-control devices (Section 544.004) and Section 545.101.

rules.title: Two-way left-turn lane: left turns only
rules.when: using a TWO-WAY LEFT-TURN LANE
rules.action: use it only to turn left into or out of the roadway
rules.statement: WHEN using a TWO-WAY LEFT-TURN LANE, the DRIVER MUST use it only to turn left into or out of the roadway.
rules.note: Texas Driver Handbook; it is unclear whether a separate statute covers this lane.

rules.title: Two-way left-turn lane: no passing or travel
rules.when: there is a TWO-WAY LEFT-TURN LANE
rules.action: use the TWO-WAY LEFT-TURN LANE for passing or as a travel lane
rules.statement: WHEN there is a TWO-WAY LEFT-TURN LANE, the DRIVER MUST NOT use the TWO-WAY LEFT-TURN LANE for passing or as a travel lane.
rules.note: Texas Driver Handbook.

rules.title: No U-turn near curve or crest
rules.when: approaching a curve or the crest of a grade AND the vehicle is not visible to the operator of another vehicle approaching from either direction within 500 feet
rules.action: make a U-TURN
rules.statement: WHEN approaching a curve or the crest of a grade AND the vehicle is not visible to the operator of another vehicle approaching from either direction within 500 feet, the DRIVER MUST NOT make a U-TURN.
rules.note: Section 545.102.

rules.title: U-turn only when legal and safe
rules.when: considering a U-TURN
rules.action: make the U-TURN
rules.unless: it is permitted at that location AND it can be made safely without interfering with other traffic
rules.statement: WHEN considering a U-TURN, the DRIVER SHOULD NOT make the U-TURN, UNLESS it is permitted at that location AND it can be made safely without interfering with other traffic.
rules.note: Texas Driver Handbook guidance; the safe-movement duty is also law under Section 545.103. Local ordinances may prohibit U-turns in business districts or at signalized intersections. Dedicated U-turn lanes ('Texas U-turns') are provided at many frontage-road interchanges.
